cover_headline: Foreign Investors Pump $7.5 Billion Into Indian Equities in Ten Sessions

end.headline: Foreign Investors Pump $7.5 Billion Into Indian Equities in Ten Sessions
end.line: The November inflow is the highest monthly figure in five years, reversing a year of heavy FPI selling.

facts: FPIs pumped $7.5 billion into Indian equities in the first 10 trading sessions of November, the highest monthly inflow in five years
FPIs pulled $13.23 billion in March alone, and withdrew $2.17 billion in October and $3.46 billion in September
Domestic institutions sold more than Rs 49,000 crore in the same 10 sessions as the Sensex and Nifty gained nearly 10%

quote.speaker: Nilesh Shah
quote.text: The FPI flows are driven by multiple factors — profit booking on AI investments, drop in oil prices, election results in Brazil, correction in Indian valuations over last two years, talks of exemptions on capital gains and reduction in rupee volatility
